title: General IT Staffing and Application Support Services
raw_description: The BC Ministry of Citizens Services requires contract staff augmentation for application support and maintenance of internal government web portals. Roles required: 2 Java developers, 1 QA analyst, 1 project coordinator. Skills required: Java Spring Boot, Oracle DB administration, JIRA, and government IMIT standards. No specific data analytics or business intelligence work is included. Duration: 12 months. Vendors must be on the BC ProServices standing offer list. This is a staffing-only engagement — no deliverables beyond staff hours.

expected_risks: Java/QA skills outside Your Organization core
ground_truth.rationale: Disqualifier: staffing-only engagement. No data analytics content. Your Organization does not compete in staff augmentation. Should be filtered at qualification stage (filter_score < 60).
